title: rs-studio built-in spectral library (format v2)
description: Schema of record for curated spectral libraries shipped with rs-studio (data/spectral/library.json). The C++ loader (SpectralLibrary::fromJson) additionally enforces shape rules that JSON Schema cannot express (array length equality, strict wavelength monotonicity, no NaN/Inf) and SpectralLibrary::validateLibrary / Library::loadValidated enforce the curation rules marked [strict] below. Curated libraries must pass loadValidated; size guidance: an uncompressed curated library stays under 5 MB by sharing dense wavelength grids and 4-decimal fixed-point reflectance values — never by dropping material classes.

format.description: Format tag shared with the v1 workbench format.

version.description: 2 = v2 fields introduced by D12 (per-entry provenance, per-entry grids).

id.description: Stable library identity referenced by lab experiments (library_id) and the knowledge layer.

bandCount.description: Shared band count; all entries of one library carry the same number of values.

wavelengths.description: Optional shared wavelength grid (nm). Entries with their own 'wavelengths' ignore it. Strictly increasing is required for any grid used in resampling/matching [strict for curated libraries].

fwhm.description: Optional shared FWHM grid (nm), sized like 'wavelengths'.

id.description: [strict] stable slug identity; unique across the library.

name.description: Display name; defaults to the id when omitted.

material.description: [strict] coarse material label from the fixed taxonomy.

wavelengths.description: [strict] band center wavelengths (nm), strictly increasing, sized like 'reflectance'. Curated libraries cover 400-2500 nm (VNIR+SWIR) so Landsat OLI/TM, Sentinel-2 MSI and GF-1/2 PMS band grids are fully covered.

reflectance.description: [strict] surface reflectance values in [0, 1]; no NaN/Inf; sized like 'wavelengths'.

spectrum.description: Legacy v1 alias of 'reflectance'. Never combine both in one entry unless the arrays are identical; the C++ reader rejects conflicts.

source.description: [strict] where the spectrum comes from; for synthetic entries the generating model/script.

license.description: [strict] license of this spectrum, from the redistributable-license allowlist; every value must be listed in data/spectral/LICENSES.md.

citation.description: [strict] attribution string; for synthetic spectra this cites the physical literature the model is grounded in.

synthetic.description: True when the spectrum is physics-model derived rather than measured.

derivation.description: [strict when synthetic=true] how the spectrum was computed; names the generator script and its parameters.

tags.description: Free-form markers; 'resampled' and 'sensor:<id>' are reserved by Library::resampleTo.
